nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: Architecture notes for the built-in tool layer: documents the typed ToolContextExtra boundary contract, permission-gate semantics (bypassAgentCheck vs deny evaluation, assertExternalDirectoryEffect as the real gate), the todo-autoclose pattern for file-mutating tools, framework-level output truncation in Tool.define, ripgrep exit-code-2 error surfacing, symlink path-traversal risks, and the SSRF DNS-rebinding fix in webfetch.
nodes.languageNotes: Each of the 13 sections is a self-contained invariant or gotcha anchored to concrete file:line references, written to be re-read by agents before modifying the tool layer.

nodes.name: apply_patch.txt
nodes.summary: LLM prompt template teaching the apply_patch diff language: the Begin/End Patch envelope, Add/Delete/Update File operation headers, rename via 'Move to', and self-healing hunk semantics where failed hunks are skipped and reported while clean hunks still apply.

nodes.name: codesearch.txt
nodes.summary: LLM prompt template for the codesearch tool backed by the Exa Code API, positioning it as the default tool for any programming research question with an adjustable 1000-50000 token budget (default 5000) for focused or comprehensive results.

nodes.name: edit.txt
nodes.summary: LLM prompt template for the edit tool's exact string-replacement rules: mandatory prior Read, preserving indentation after the line-number prefix, oldString uniqueness failure modes, replaceAll for renames, and routing multi-file edits to apply_patch.

nodes.name: glob.txt
nodes.summary: LLM prompt template for the glob file-pattern matcher: results sorted by modification time, batching multiple speculative searches in one response, and preferring the Task tool for open-ended multi-round exploration.

nodes.name: grep.txt
nodes.summary: LLM prompt template for the regex content-search tool: include-pattern file filtering, path-and-line-number results sorted by modification time, delegating match counting to Bash rg, and routing open-ended searches to the Task tool.

nodes.name: index-workspace.txt
nodes.summary: LLM prompt template for index_workspace, which chunks workspace source files and generates vector embeddings (local model by default, OpenAI when configured) as the prerequisite step before semantic search; takes 10-60 seconds depending on workspace size.

nodes.name: lsp.txt
nodes.summary: LLM prompt template for the LSP tool enumerating nine code-intelligence operations (goToDefinition, findReferences, hover, documentSymbol, workspaceSymbol, goToImplementation, and the call-hierarchy trio) with their 1-based line/character parameter requirements.

nodes.name: plan-enter.txt
nodes.summary: LLM prompt template for the plan_enter tool, which suggests switching to the plan agent when a complex request would benefit from planning first, with explicit guidance on when to call and when not to call it.

nodes.name: plan-exit.txt
nodes.summary: LLM prompt template for the plan_exit tool, which asks the user to switch from the plan agent to the build agent once a complete plan has been written to the plan file and all clarifying questions are resolved.

nodes.name: question.txt
nodes.summary: LLM prompt template for the question tool's structured user Q&A: an automatic 'type your own answer' option when custom is enabled, multiple-select answers returned as label arrays, and the recommended-option-first labeling convention.

nodes.name: read.txt
nodes.summary: LLM prompt template for the read tool's file and directory semantics: 2000-line default window, 1-indexed offset paging, the 'line: content' prefix contract, parallel reads for multiple files, image/PDF attachment support, and onlyHunks for reading only git-modified ranges with 3 context lines.

nodes.name: repo_clone.txt
nodes.summary: LLM prompt template for repo_clone, which clones or refreshes external repositories into OpenCode's managed cache from git URLs, forge host/path references, or GitHub owner/repo shorthand, returning the cached local path for dependency and documentation research.

nodes.name: repo_overview.txt
nodes.summary: LLM prompt template for repo_overview, which summarizes a cloned repository's detected ecosystems, dependency files, package manager, likely entrypoints, and a compact structure tree so the agent can orient quickly after repo_clone.

nodes.name: semantic-search.txt
nodes.summary: LLM prompt template for semantic_search: vector-embedding search that finds conceptually similar code and returns ranked snippets with relevance scores, requires a prior index_workspace run, and includes routing guidance versus grep for exact patterns.

nodes.name: skill.txt
nodes.summary: LLM prompt template for the skill tool, which loads a specialized skill matching one listed in the system prompt and injects its instructions and directory resources (scripts, files) into the current conversation.

nodes.name: task.txt
nodes.summary: LLM prompt template for the Task subagent launcher: subagent_type selection, launching multiple agents concurrently in a single message, task_id session resume, fresh-context briefing requirements, slash-command delegation, and when to prefer Read/Glob instead.

nodes.name: todowrite.txt
nodes.summary: LLM prompt template for TodoWrite, the largest template in the tool layer: when-to-use and when-not-to-use guidance illustrated with four positive and four negative worked examples (each with a reasoning block), task states (pending, in_progress, completed, cancelled), and single-in-progress management rules.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses few-shot <example>/<reasoning> block structure mirroring Anthropic's TodoWrite prompt conventions to teach proactive task tracking behavior.

nodes.name: webfetch.txt
nodes.summary: LLM prompt template for webfetch: URL content fetching with markdown/text/html format conversion, automatic HTTP-to-HTTPS upgrade, read-only semantics, summarization of large content, and deferring to better-suited fetching tools when available.

nodes.name: websearch.txt
nodes.summary: LLM prompt template for websearch: real-time web search via the session's configured provider with live-crawling modes (fallback/preferred), search types (auto/fast/deep), domain filtering, and a {{year}} placeholder that must be filled with the current year for recency-sensitive queries.
nodes.languageNotes: Contains a {{year}} placeholder substituted at prompt-render time so generated search queries include the current year.
